integrity: Full proof, exact formula, finite independent test program and reproducible checks embedded. Computational testing corroborates but does not prove the unrestricted theorem.
scientific_limitations: Finite nonempty deterministic total frames; no claims for general branching transition systems. Classical word-period and partition-refinement lemmas treated as known ingredients. Specialized antecedents in unary automata may exist; independent mathematical and originality review remains outstanding.
title: Exact observable-labeling census for finite deterministic modal frames
